package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

func (store Store) Claim(ctx context.Context, claim repository.OutboxClaim) ([]domain.IntegrationEvent, error) {
	if store.Pool == nil || strings.TrimSpace(claim.WorkerID) == "" || claim.Limit < 1 ||
		claim.Now.IsZero() || !claim.LockedUntil.After(claim.Now) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT event_id FROM planner_outbox
    WHERE published_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at <= $1
      AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until <= $1)
    ORDER BY occurred_at, event_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $2
)
UPDATE planner_outbox AS event
SET locked_by=$3, locked_until=$4, attempts=event.attempts+1
FROM candidates WHERE event.event_id=candidates.event_id
RETURNING event.event_id,event.subject,event.correlation_id,event.causation_id,event.student_id,
          event.occurred_at,event.schema_version,event.payload,event.attempts`,
		claim.Now.UTC(), claim.Limit, claim.WorkerID, claim.LockedUntil.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := make([]domain.IntegrationEvent, 0, claim.Limit)
	for rows.Next() {
		var event domain.IntegrationEvent
		var payload []byte
		if err := rows.Scan(&event.EventID, &event.Subject, &event.CorrelationID, &event.CausationID,
			&event.StudentID, &event.OccurredAt, &event.SchemaVersion, &payload, &event.Attempts); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !json.Valid(payload) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		event.Payload = append(json.RawMessage(nil), payload...)
		result = append(result, event)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (store Store) MarkPublished(ctx context.Context, eventID, workerID string, at time.Time) error {
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE planner_outbox
SET published_at=$3,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL
WHERE event_id=$1 AND locked_by=$2 AND published_at IS NULL`, eventID, workerID, at.UTC())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return errors.New("outbox publication lease lost")
	}
	return nil
}

func (store Store) MarkFailed(ctx context.Context, eventID, workerID, message string, retryAt time.Time) error {
	if len(message) > 2000 {
		message = message[:2000]
	}
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE planner_outbox
SET next_attempt_at=$3,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,last_error=$4
WHERE event_id=$1 AND locked_by=$2 AND published_at IS NULL`, eventID, workerID, retryAt.UTC(), message)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return errors.New("outbox failure lease lost")
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.Outbox = Store{}
